d.why: Mr. Fox, head of the mercenary guards on Morbius's ship, has one scene: he snipes at Martine in the lab and is among those killed when Morbius turns, and the story never turns on him.
Barrow is one of the NYPD officers who stop Michael and Milo in the subway and are taken down by Milo, a one-scene victim.
Ryan runs the counterfeiting lab that Morbius takes over in Morbius; he asks a couple of questions, has his hand broken and runs, all in one short scene.
Simkins, Norman Osborn's secretary, only brings him the news that Stromm is dead and the flight suit and glider were stolen, in one short scene of Spider-Man (2002).
Raymond, a scientist on Otto's team, has one line at the fusion demonstration in Spider-Man 2 announcing a successful reaction.
The theatre usher who won't let a late Peter into Mary Jane's play is a one-scene comic cameo, credited by his job, not a name.
Mr. Jacks, the bank officer, turns down May's loan in the one bank scene of Spider-Man 2, just before Doctor Octopus robs the bank.
Dr. Isaacs is the surgeon who plans to cut off Otto's arms and is killed by them, in one hospital scene of Spider-Man 2.
Joan Jameson, Jonah's wife, only stands at his side at the planetarium and the wedding and says one line ('The caterer?'), with no part in the story.
Mary Jane's mother only helps her get ready in the wedding scene of Spider-Man 2, and that brief moment changes nothing.
Algernon is only the role an actor plays opposite Mary Jane in The Importance of Being Earnest, seen on stage, not a person in the story.
The French restaurant host who helps Peter set up his proposal is a one-scene comic cameo in Spider-Man 3, credited by his job, not a name.
Emma Marko, Flint's wife, confronts the escaped Flint at their apartment, calls him a thief and orders him to leave their sick daughter, setting up why he wants the money in Spider-Man 3.
Penny Marko, Flint's terminally ill daughter, is the reason behind everything the Sandman does in Spider-Man 3; she gives him her pendant and tells him 'I missed you too, Daddy'.
Miles's aunt Maria is only a guest at Jeff's promotion party in Across the Spider-Verse, with no part in the plot.
Sun-Spider is one of the many Spider-Society members, with a single fan line to Miles at Nueva York, a cameo.
Armadillo is only one of the villains glimpsed in Across the Spider-Verse, with no lines in the transcript and no part in the plot.

Miss Calleros, Miles's physics teacher at Brooklyn Visions, teaches the parallel-universe theory, sees through his deliberate zero, refuses to let him quit and gives him the personal essay he finishes at the film's end in Into the Spider-Verse.
C. Salas, the Brooklyn Visions security guard, only shouts that Miles snuck out and chases him in one short scene of Into the Spider-Verse.

Troy is Jack's father, whose son Spider-Man saves on the Williamsburg Bridge in The Amazing Spider-Man; he later rallies the crane operators to line up their cranes so the wounded Spider-Man can reach Oscorp.
Missy Kallenback is a bullied Midtown classmate who protests when Flash throws a ball at her in The Amazing Spider-Man; the plot never turns on her.
Mr. Cramer is a Midtown teacher who only tells Peter to keep his skateboard off the floor, one line in The Amazing Spider-Man.
T-Bone is the store clerk who mocks Peter and refuses him the milk over two cents, so Peter lets the robber go, the thief who then kills Uncle Ben in The Amazing Spider-Man.
Nicky is a street thug Peter beats up and dangles from a roof while hunting Uncle Ben's killer, one scene in The Amazing Spider-Man that changes nothing.
Nicky's girlfriend has a few lines in the one alley scene where Peter beats up Nicky, and her credit describes her rather than naming her.
Rudy is the subway passenger whose prank and fight show Peter his new reflexes, his only scene in The Amazing Spider-Man.
Ariel is a cheerleader who only watches Peter's slam dunk in The Amazing Spider-Man, with no lines.
Aleksei Sytsevich, the Russian mobster who hijacks the Oscorp plutonium truck and comes back as the Rhino in The Amazing Spider-Man 2, already has the app's Rhino file for that film.
